title: Lazy pipelines: filter and choose columns early
objectives: Say why loading everything and filtering in Python is slow
Push filters and column choices into the engine
Recognise the same idea in Polars lazy frames, DuckDB and Spark

exercises.prompt: Return North's 2026 revenue by product: product and revenue, in product order. Let the engine do the filtering and adding up.
hints: The starter brings back every row and column, as df = pd.read_parquet(...) would, for Python to sift.
Keep only region = 'North' and 2026 dates in WHERE, with a date range so the engine can skip data.
SELECT product, sum(amount) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE region = 'North' AND sold_on >= DATE '2026-01-01' AND sold_on < DATE '2027-01-01' GROUP BY product ORDER BY product
